notes: Ask your school CTE teacher or counselor too. Confirm the spring dates with OC Pathways.
name: OC Pathways Student Ambassador Program
org: OC Pathways (Orange County Department of Education)
what_you_do: Represent your school district at the county level. Push for student voice in career classes (CTE). Meet industry mentors. Lead a year-long Impact Project to fix a real need in your school or community.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 who want to take their leadership to the next level. The page does not list other eligibility rules.
duration: One school year, built around a year-long Impact Project
deadline_text: The page says students apply in spring. Exact dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply in spring. The page does not link a form, so email Nadia Khodadadi at OC Pathways (address on the page) to ask how to apply.
